subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw continue persisting full `systemPromptReport` in every session entry, or persist only the small warning-dedupe state and rebuild or move the large report details elsewhere?
rationale: Current tests encode full-report persistence as intentional warning-dedupe state, while recent production data shows the same field dominates session-store size; automation should not choose that storage contract alone.

options.title: Persist Only Dedupe State
options.body: Store the small `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen` state needed after restart and omit or rebuild large tools, skills, and prompt-report details from inactive session rows.

options.title: Keep Full Report Inline
options.body: Accept the current session-store size tradeoff and handle bloat through pruning, caps, and live operational guidance instead of changing report durability.

options.title: Move Report To Canonical Storage
options.body: Move detailed reports out of the per-session index behind the session storage boundary, with cleanup semantics and migration/compaction for existing rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Only Dedupe State
recommendation.body: Store the small `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen` state needed after restart and omit or rebuild large tools, skills, and prompt-report details from inactive session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass ties this owner to the original prompt-report feature and later session-store refactors, making them the strongest available product-direction owner.
